title: 溶液的化学：从溶解到析出

sentences.en: Today let's look at one of the most common processes in chemistry: what happens when a substance dissolves in water.
sentences.zh: 今天我们来看化学里最常见的过程之一：一种物质溶于水时会发生什么。

sentences.en: When you stir salt into water, the salt is the solute, the water is the solvent, and together they form a solution.
sentences.zh: 当你把盐搅进水里，盐是溶质，水是溶剂，二者共同形成溶液。

sentences.en: Water is often called the universal solvent, so an aqueous solution is where most reactions in living things happen.
sentences.zh: 水常被称为万能溶剂，所以水溶液正是生物体内大多数反应发生的地方。

sentences.en: A key idea is solubility, and whether something is soluble depends on how its molecules interact with water.
sentences.zh: 一个关键概念是溶解度；一种物质是否可溶，取决于它的分子如何与水相互作用。

sentences.en: At the level of the atom, salt is really built from ions, so when it dissolves, a positive and a negative ion drift apart.
sentences.zh: 在原子层面，盐其实是由离子构成的，所以它溶解时，一个正离子和一个负离子彼此分开。

sentences.en: This differs from a chemical reaction, where the bonds inside a molecule break and new bonds form a new compound.
sentences.zh: 这与化学反应不同：在化学反应里，分子内部的化学键断裂，新的化学键形成，从而生成一种新的化合物。

sentences.en: Take an acid and a base: mix them, the acid supplies hydrogen ions, and the products are a salt and water.
sentences.zh: 以酸和碱为例：把它们混合，酸提供氢离子，生成物就是盐和水。

sentences.en: Here the reactants are converted into products, and the element sodium ends up in a compound with different properties.
sentences.zh: 在这里，反应物被转化为生成物，钠元素最终进入一种性质不同的化合物中。

sentences.en: A reaction can run faster when you raise the concentration of the reactants, or when you add a catalyst.
sentences.zh: 当你提高反应物的浓度，或加入催化剂时，反应可以进行得更快。

sentences.en: A catalyst speeds up a reaction without being used up itself, which is exactly how enzymes in your body work.
sentences.zh: 催化剂能加快反应而自身不被消耗，你体内的酶正是这样工作的。

sentences.en: Another whole family of reactions, built on the exchange of electrons, is called oxidation and reduction.
sentences.zh: 另一整类反应建立在电子的转移之上，称为氧化和还原。

sentences.en: In oxidation a substance loses electrons, which is why iron rusts, while in reduction it gains them back.
sentences.zh: 在氧化中，物质失去电子，这正是铁生锈的原因；而在还原中，它又把电子重新得回。

sentences.en: Now, to recover the solid salt, you can heat the solution so the water will evaporate and the dissolved salt is left to crystallize.
sentences.zh: 现在，要把固体盐取回来，你可以加热溶液，让水蒸发，留下的溶解的盐便会结晶。

sentences.en: You can also mix two solutions so that an insoluble product suddenly precipitates out as a solid.
sentences.zh: 你也可以混合两种溶液，让一种不溶的生成物突然作为固体沉淀析出。

sentences.en: So chemistry gives us two opposite moves: synthesis builds a compound from simpler pieces, while heat can make a compound decompose into simpler ones.
sentences.zh: 所以化学给了我们两个相反的动作：合成用更简单的部分构建复杂的化合物，而加热能让一种化合物分解成更简单的物质。

sentences.en: Once you see molecules, ions, and bonds as the players, dissolving, crystallizing, and reacting become one molecular story.
sentences.zh: 一旦你把分子、离子和化学键看作主角，溶解、结晶和反应就都成了同一个分子层面的故事。
